description:
Keeping Promises to Yourself! — Leo promised Ms. Maple he would protect the shiny dinosaur book! But where did he leave it when playtime started?
Kids science answer for "keeping promises and responsibility kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Your word is your bond. When you promise to care for borrowed books or toys, returning them safe builds ironclad trust with everyone.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
